tldr: Sun in the 12th house: identity becomes personal through rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life.
body:
With the Sun in the 12th house, this part of you develops through rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to what happens behind the scenes, including fatigue, private processing, unfinished feelings, and the need to step back.

When this placement is supported, you can make room for what needs quiet, closure, or a softer pace. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, avoidance can look like rest, and silence can start carrying more than it should. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life.
